summary.content:
Today's selection covers 97 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 69 on Artificial Intelligence and 22 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: In Other News: Dolphin X AI-Powered Malware, Car Anti-Theft Device Hack, 400 Linux Kernel Flaws
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 40 articles published in the last 24 hours
